reviews.title: Elegant and straightforward
reviews.text:
I'm attempting the slow carb 4HB diet and was looking for an app to track body measurements and wanted the ability to store multiple photos with them. This one caught my eye because there was no fluff on it: no goofy color scheme, no extraneous graphics, and no ads! There's no tutorial on how to use it, but it's so straightforward and minimal you don't really need one, you just tap on the icons to see what's available for you to do. Results are plotted on a graph that you can pinch to zoom in order to see different ranges of time. If all you're looking to track are measurements for weight, chest, waist, hips, thigh, bicep, calf, you're good to go. A couple of these measurements aren't available in the free version, and the app will tell you when you try to enter them. You unlock them all for 99 cents, which is well worth it to me for no ads.

The only hiccup I ran into was the app wouldn't access my camera, even after I gave it permission, even after upgrading to unlimited, even after restarting the app and then the phone. I was able to pick photos from my photo roll, though. The next day the camera function magically worked, not really sure what changed. The only cons I can think of are that you don't store measurements for each thigh/bicep/calf (you input the average), and there's no option for neck (doesn’t matter to me). I had no problem upgrading to the paid unlimited version (ios 11.3.1, iphone x).
